title: India CPI 6.09% — Inflation crosses RBI red line #Shorts
description:
India's October 2026 CPI hit 6.09%, first time above RBI's 6% ceiling in 2 years. Food inflation at 8.5%+. Dec 2-4 RBI meeting now a live rate-hike call. If you have a home loan, your EMI could change.
